clips.title: CoreWeave毛利改善 但回报仍远低于融资成本
title_lines: 但回报仍远低于融资成本
AI算力需求能否撑起估值？

subtitles.en: every time we talk, I mean, I'm always curious about these kind of, uh, you know, these neoclouds and whether kind of these sort of fanceliary players in the hyperscalers space
subtitles.zh: 每次我们聊，我都对这些新型云服务商很好奇，它们能否在超大规模云市场中立足。

subtitles.en: are actually legit. When you look at these numbers today, does it give you a little bit more sense of proof of life or what? It's incrementally positive. There is still a really big question
subtitles.zh: 今天的数据是否让你觉得它们更有生命力？确实有积极信号，但仍有大问题。

subtitles.en: about whether we even need neoclouds, whether they're a good business. At the base of it is, are they getting a good enough return on investment to pay for the very expensive capital that
subtitles.zh: 我们是否真的需要这些新型云服务商？它们能否获得足够回报来覆盖高昂的借贷成本？

subtitles.en: they have to borrow? And I think that what investors are seeing today, if they took a small step in the right direction, separating margins, which were only 1% last quarter out now 5%. So that's
subtitles.zh: 市场参与者今天看到的是，它们迈出了正确的一步，利润率从上一季度的1%提升到5%。

subtitles.en: not a lot. That still means a 1% return on invested capital, but it's a step in the right direction.
subtitles.zh: 虽然5%不算高，但**资本回报率仍只有1%，不过方向是对的。

subtitles.en: So a step in the right direction, is it a durable step, a long term step, or is this just, you know, they're taking the advantage of what right now is just kind of a crazy market?
subtitles.zh: 这是可持续的长期趋势，还是只是利用当前市场的狂热？

subtitles.en: Let's put it in perspective. So if I'm saying they're getting about a 1% return on assets, their borrowing cost has actually just gone up. It was closer to 8% and now it's close to 10%.
subtitles.zh: 客观来看，资产回报率约1%，而借贷成本已从8%升至接近10%。

subtitles.en: So you're borrowing at 10% to get a 1% return. That's not good news. So again, they have to improve the returns very significantly. And that's reduced the cost to capital, which recently
subtitles.zh: 以10%的成本借入资金，却只获得1%的回报，这并非好消息。

subtitles.en: has actually gone the wrong way. That's why we're questioning the whole category is that this is like borrowing on margin to buy treasuries, borrowing a 10% to buy a 5% return isn't a good idea.
subtitles.zh: 因此，整个类别受到质疑，就像用保证金买国债，借10%去赚5%并不明智。

clip_research.source_claim: CoreWeave's gross margin improved from 1% to 5%, but return on invested capital is still only 1%, while borrowing costs have risen from 8% to 10%.
clip_research.public_baseline: CoreWeave reported strong Q4 and FY2025 results with revenue reaching $5 billion, and gross margin is typically above 70% according to some sources.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The clip claims gross margin is only 5%, which contradicts public reports of high gross margins (74.5% LTM). The clip may be referring to a different metric or a specific quarter.

evidence.fact: Gil Luria states gross margin improved from 1% to 5% and borrowing cost increased from 8% to 10%.
A substack analysis reports gross margin of 74.5% LTM, contradicting the clip's 5% figure.
A substack article notes effective interest rates exceed 10% on some loans, supporting the borrowing cost claim.

大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
